text:
40,000 requests per minute from one API key. Connection pools gone. Legitimate users saw 503s while we blocked IPs by hand.

Scaling Postgres would not have fixed it — the traffic should never have reached the database.

New case study: gateway placement, token bucket vs sliding windows, Redis + Lua for distributed limits, 429 headers, and fail-open vs fail-closed.
